name: interrupt
wording: at a hold point its holder, the party whose handoff it is, ends its turn with a sign-off request and resumes only on the operator's answer; under delegation of authority it takes the sign-off instead; the request alone marks it: nothing detects one from a reply's wording or announces it apart, and nothing hides its content from whoever delegated the work
reason: Comparing the readings: the design held that a hold point is known by its request alone, never detected from wording or announced apart, and never hidden from the delegator; the restated concepts had dropped it.
